name: Everyday Checking
description: A day-to-day current account with a debit card, mobile app and free transfers. The $8 monthly fee is waived with a $1,500 balance or $500 in monthly direct deposits.

name: Student Checking
description: No monthly fee for full-time students aged 17 to 25, no minimum balance, and no fee if you go overdrawn by $50 or less. Ideal for a first bank account.

name: Premier Checking
description: Premium current account with a dedicated relationship manager, free international wires, no ATM fees worldwide and express card replacement. Fee waived with $25,000 in combined balances.

name: High-Yield Savings
description: Grow an emergency fund or save for a home deposit with a variable 4.10% APY and no monthly fee. Six free withdrawals a month.

name: Kids Saver
description: A savings account for children under 17, opened and managed by a parent or guardian. Teaches saving habits with goals in the app.

name: 12-Month CD
description: Lock in a fixed 4.50% APY for 12 months from a $1,000 minimum deposit. An early withdrawal costs 90 days of interest.

name: 24-Month CD
description: A fixed 4.25% APY for two years from a $1,000 minimum deposit, for savings you will not need soon. An early withdrawal costs 180 days of interest.

name: Business Checking
description: A current account for small businesses: 200 free transactions a month, payroll and invoicing integrations, and multiple users with their own cards.

name: Business Savings
description: Keep your business reserves and tax money separate and earning a variable 3.20% APY, with instant transfers to Business Checking.

name: Cashback Card
description: A credit card with 1.5% cashback on every purchase and no annual fee. Contactless and mobile wallet payments, with instant card freeze in the app.

name: Voyager Travel Card
description: A travel credit card with no foreign transaction fees, 3 points per dollar on flights and hotels, and travel insurance. Good for spending abroad.

name: Starter Credit Card
description: Build a credit history with a low starting limit from $500, no annual fee and payment reminders. Designed for students and people new to credit.

name: Balance Transfer Card
description: Move expensive card debt here and pay 0% APR on transferred balances for 18 months (3% transfer fee), then 21.99%. A plan to pay down debt faster.

name: Business Card
description: A business credit card with employee cards, spending limits per employee, and expense exports to accounting software.

name: Personal Loan
description: Borrow $2,000 to $50,000 over 12 to 60 months at a fixed APR from 7.99% to 19.99%, for home improvements, a wedding or debt consolidation. No early repayment fee.

name: Auto Loan
description: Finance a new or used car over 24 to 72 months at a fixed APR from 6.49%, with a decision in one business day.

name: Student Loan Refinance
description: Combine existing student loans into one fixed monthly payment from 5.75% APR, for graduates with a steady income.

name: 30-Year Fixed Mortgage
description: Buy your first home or move house with a fixed rate for 30 years and predictable monthly payments, from a 5% deposit.

name: Home Equity Line of Credit
description: Borrow against the value of your home as you need it, for renovations or large expenses, at a variable APR. Pay interest only on what you use.

name: Small Business Loan
description: Fund equipment, stock or expansion for your business with $10,000 to $250,000 over up to 7 years, at a fixed APR from 9.25%.
